notes.title: THEY'RE HERE! 😱
notes.content: [h3]Are you ready for [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3553320/Them/"]THEM[/url][/b]?! 😱[/h3][p]My new game is now available on Steam 🔥 It's a combination of a first-person psychological experience and a 2D platformer. I would be happy if you try it out and share your thoughts about it.[/p][p]Let's play a different game together... 🎮😰[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748477/9c006c731e8a33cea6b150b80894eeca91901e25.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3553320/Them/"][/dynamiclink][/h2]
